comment: Pinned external-tool payloads shipped under resources/tools by scripts/vendor-tools.mjs. Binaries are build output and are NOT committed; this manifest and its SHA-256 pins are. Add a tool by adding an entry here, then run the script. Tier order: tier 1 proves the pipeline with the two required/most-used tools; tier 2 adds content-discovery and template scanning; tier 3 needs a Python/Perl runtime and is opt-in.

tools.note: nmap.org publishes a win32 ZIP only up to 7.92; newer releases are installer-only, so this is the newest redistributable tree. Npcap is NOT bundled: SYN scans and OS detection need an elevated install, while the runner's connect-scan fallback (nmap/privilege.ts) maps ports unprivileged. The VC++ app-local DLLs are included in the tree, which removes the VC++ redistributable requirement.
Content and directory discovery. Needs the bundled wordlist (resources/tools/wordlists/common.txt), which vendor-tools.mjs copies out of the vendored runner payload.

Left unpinned deliberately: the nuclei release archive is a large self-updating binary and the template checkout is a separate, operator-updated tree. Until a version is pinned here, the runner keeps reporting nuclei as a missing optional prerequisite.
